dimensions.assessment: Directly affects veterans receiving service-connected disability compensation, dependents, and survivors receiving dependency and indemnity compensation.
dimensions.evidence: rates of compensation for veterans with service-connected disabilities and the rates of dependency and indemnity compensation for the survivors of certain disabled veterans

dimensions.assessment: Provides a financial adjustment matching Social Security cost-of-living increases, which is a standard recurring benefit modification.
dimensions.evidence: increased by the same percentage as the percentage by which benefit amounts payable under title II of the Social Security Act... are increased

dimensions.assessment: Involves increased federal expenditures commensurate with the percentage adjustment applied to various VA compensation programs.
dimensions.evidence: Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall increase... the dollar amounts in effect on November 30, 2026, for the payment of disability compensation

dimensions.assessment: Amends payment amounts and publication requirements under existing titles of the United States Code without creating new federal programs.
dimensions.evidence: increase, in accordance with subsection (c), the dollar amounts in effect on November 30, 2026, for the payment of disability compensation

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent rate adjustment effective December 1, 2026, with continuing nationwide application.
dimensions.evidence: Effective on December 1, 2026, the Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall increase... the dollar amounts

missing_information: The exact percentage increase of the Social Security cost-of-living adjustment for 2026 is not yet determined, so the precise fiscal cost cannot be calculated from the text.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates a cost-of-living adjustment to several categories of veterans' compensation matching Social Security increases, affecting disability and survivor benefits nationwide.

card.summary: H.R. 8552, the Veterans' Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2026, directs the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to increase the rates of disability compensation for veterans with service-connected disabilities and the rates of dependency and indemnity compensation for eligible survivors, effective December 1, 2026.
